chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Ibrāhīm ibn ʿUqbah, from ʿAmr ibn ʿUthmān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

A group came to Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام seeking his legal verdict, but they did not find him. So al-Ḥasan عليه السلام said to them: “Bring me your question. If I am correct, then it is from Allah and from Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, and if I err, then Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام is behind you.”

They said: “A woman whose husband had intercourse with her then arose with the heat of his intercourse, and she engaged in siḥāq with a virgin slave-girl, casting the semen upon her, and she became pregnant.”

He عليه السلام said: “Immediately, this woman is to be charged with the dower of this virgin, because the child does not come out until the virginity is removed. She is to be awaited until she gives birth, then the legal punishment is to be carried out upon her, the child is to be ascribed to the owner of the semen, and the married woman is to be stoned.”

Then they departed and met Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام. They said: “We asked al-Ḥasan, and al-Ḥasan said to us such-and-such.” He said: “By Allah, had you met Abā al-Ḥasan, there would have been with him nothing except what al-Ḥasan said.”

key_terms.النُّطْفَةَ: the semen by which conception occurred
key_terms.بِصَدَاقِ: with the dower or financial compensation due
key_terms.فَسَاحَقَتْ: she engaged in siḥāq with another woman
key_terms.فُتْيَاكُمْ: your legal question or matter for fatwa
key_terms.يَسْتَفْتُونَهُ: seeking his legal verdict or juridical ruling
key_terms.يُلْحَقُ: is legally ascribed or affiliated in lineage

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Shia hadith on a woman who causes another woman to become pregnant through transferred semen?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts a legal question presented to al-Ḥasan عليه السلام in the absence of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, and his ruling was later affirmed by Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام. It addresses a rare juridical case involving siḥāq, pregnancy, lineage, compensation for loss of virginity, and the prescribed legal punishment. The report also highlights the transmitted knowledge and legal authority of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.
